SELECT r.* FROM gkzh_zyfxq_record r
ORDER BY r.record_id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS finishedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.result = 'win' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS winCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.result = 'lose' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS loseCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status = 'playing' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS playingCount, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN r.status = 'finished' AND r.duration_ms IS NOT NULL THEN r.duration_ms END), 0) AS avgDurationMs, COALESCE(SUM(r.roll_count), 0) AS rollTotal, COALESCE(SUM(r.step_total), 0) AS stepTotal, COALESCE(SUM(r.answer_count), 0) AS answerTotal, COALESCE(SUM(r.correct_count), 0) AS correctTotal, COALESCE(SUM(r.timeout_count), 0) AS timeoutTotal FROM gkzh_zyfxq_record r

SELECT a.question_type AS questionType, COUNT(*) AS answerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correctCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_timeout = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS timeoutCount, COALESCE(AVG(a.cost_ms), 0) AS avgCostMs FROM gkzh_zyfxq_answer a JOIN gkzh_zyfxq_record r ON r.record_id = a.record_id
GROUP BY a.question_type

SELECT a.question_id AS questionId, MAX(a.question_type) AS questionType, MAX(a.question_title) AS questionTitle, COUNT(*) AS answerCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_correct = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS correctCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.is_timeout = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS timeoutCount, COALESCE(AVG(a.cost_ms), 0) AS avgCostMs FROM gkzh_zyfxq_answer a JOIN gkzh_zyfxq_record r ON r.record_id = a.record_id
GROUP BY a.question_id ORDER BY answerCount DESC, a.question_id ASC
SELECT * FROM gkzh_zyfxq_record WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND game_type = 'zyfxq' ORDER BY record_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
